# Recipe — add a tunable config value

**Use when:** a number or flag needs to be tunable without a code change (balance, cooldowns,
thresholds). **Never** hardcode it in a Model.

## 1. Edit the manifest

`Tools/Codegen/Manifests/game.configkeys.json` — append one entry:

```json
{ "id": "ShopRefreshHours", "type": "float", "value": "shop.refreshHours", "order": 6 }
```

| Field | Rule |
|---|---|
| `id` | The generated member name: `GameConfigKeys.ShopRefreshHours`. |
| `type` | The value type. Carried into the generated `ConfigKey<T>`. |
| `value` | The dotted remote key string. Lowercase, `area.name`. |
| `order` | Next free integer. |

## 2. Generate

```
Framework/Codegen/Generate          (editor menu)
# or: Tools/Build/pf-build.sh codegen
```

`Assets/<Sku>/Gen/GameConfigKeys.gen.cs` gains the typed key. **Never hand-edit a `.gen.cs` file.**

## 3. Register the default — this step is not optional

The framework registers **no** `ConfigDefaults`. **The SKU's game installer owns the single
registration**, keyed to the generated `ConfigKey<T>` values:

```csharp
builder.RegisterInstance(new ConfigDefaults(new Dictionary<string, object>
{
    [GameConfigKeys.ShopRefreshHours.Value] = 6f,
    // … every other key
}));
```

The value's **runtime type declares the key's type** for per-key validation of the remote layer.

| Mistake | Result |
|---|---|
| Two `ConfigDefaults` registrations | VContainer resolution conflict at boot. |
| No registration at all | Every `Get` silently returns `0` — the classic "the ball froze" bug. |

`Framework/Doctor` check 8 gates exactly this.

## 4. Read it

```csharp
var hours = _config.Get(GameConfigKeys.ShopRefreshHours);
```

Precedence is **bundled default → remote override → local A/B**, merged per key. The untrusted
remote layer is validated per key: an unknown key or an unparseable value becomes a `ConfigSkip`
**returned as data, never thrown**. A garbage remote payload therefore yields exactly the bundled
defaults plus a populated skip list — it can never crash the game or zero out a value.

## 5. Gate

```sh
Tools/Build/pf-build.sh codegen --check    # exit 1 = the generated key is stale
```

## Related

- A **remote-only** value with no bundled default is not addressable — it will be skipped as
  `UnknownKey`. Every key needs a default.
- Values that a **Model** consumes are passed in through its constructor, not read from a service
  inside the Model. A Model reads no services and no `Time.*` (rules #14, #15).
